title: Maps

exercises.title: Create Map
exercises.description: Create a map ages with keys "Alice" (25), "Bob" (30). Print the map.

exercises.title: Map Lookup
exercises.description: Create map scores = HashMap{"Math": 95, "Physics": 88}. Look up "Math" and System.out.println the score.

exercises.title: Add to Map
exercises.description: Create empty map names = empty HashMap. Add entries: "1" -> "One", "2" -> "Two". Print map.

exercises.title: Delete from Map
exercises.description: Create map data = HashMap{"a": 1, "b": 2, "c": 3}. Delete "b", then System.out.println the map.
hints: After `remove("b")` or building without `b`, print `{a=1, c=3}`.
The starter may already omit `b` in the solution.

exercises.title: Check Key Existence
exercises.description: Create map inventory = HashMap{"apples": 5, "oranges": 3}. Check if "bananas" exists and System.out.println exists or not found.
hints: Use `inventory.containsKey("bananas")` with a ternary selecting `"exists"` vs `"not found"`.
Print `not found` for the sample data.

exercises.title: Map Length
exercises.description: Create map counts = HashMap{"one": 1, "two": 2, "three": 3}. Print the number of entries using len().

exercises.title: Iterate Map
exercises.description: Create map grades = HashMap{"A": 90, "B": 80, "C": 70}. Print each key-value pair.
